title: EntitlementState
description: Spec-ahead (ADR 0008). A user's plan state as the resolver sees it. RevenueCat is the source of truth for the paid plan (App User ID = Firebase UID); the app reads it from RevenueCat customer info and never trusts a client-written plan for cloud modules. Picks, trials, the active-inventory selection and hidden modules are app data and are client-enforced for on-device modules. With Blaze, RevenueCat's Firebase integration writes a trusted copy of `plan` and `source` (document plus custom claim) that clients cannot write; cloud modules check only that copy. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

uid.description: Firebase UID, equal to the RevenueCat App User ID

plan.description: free when RevenueCat reports no active entitlement

provider.description: household: the plan comes from membership in another user's Pro or Family household

store.description: Where the plan was bought: playStore (Play Billing), web (RevenueCat Web Billing with Stripe), appStore (later). One RevenueCat customer record spans all of them

periodEnd.description: End of the current billing period (RevenueCat expiration date)

gracePeriodEndsAt.description: Set while a payment failed and the 7-day grace period runs; the plan stays active until then

picks.description: Plus only: the chosen automation modules

lastSwapAt.description: At most one swap per calendar month, whatever the billing period

trials.description: One record per trialed module; each trialable module can be trialed once per user. A Plus user may trial a module they have not picked

module.description: id of a trialable onDevice module

activeInventoryIds.description: After a downgrade over the inventory limit: the inventories the user picked as active; the others are read-only. null = not over the limit

role.description: subscriber holds the plan; minor is an invited member aged 13 to 17 (Family only)

invitedBy.description: UID of the consenting adult; required for minors
